# Fixture asset license

The Last Light's story, dialogue, room layouts, palette and fixture data in
`game.json` were created for this repository. These original demo assets are
dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The demo uses geometric shapes rather than external artwork. The desktop viewer
uses Bevy's bundled Fira Mono font, distributed by Bevy under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1. No PACE mascot, reference-site artwork, music or third-party game
assets are included.
